# Better Than Marketplace: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-14 · code 1a1214ff5376 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Sell the stuff you don't need in seconds: snap a photo with your phone, give it a name, done. No categories, no forms, no fees. Browse what neighbours sell nearby.
**Live:** https://bettermart.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/better-than-marketplace · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/betterthanmarketplace/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py betterthanmarketplace` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Engines stay JS** in `theme/assets/btm.js` (window.BTM): Leaflet maps (`pickerMap` for Dialogs/SpotPicker, `areaMap` for Components/AreaMap), Nominatim search/reverse (on a tap only), photo shrinking (`shrink`: 1600 px + 560 px JPEG), share, confetti, lightbox, geolocation. `client_code/btm.py` is the only Python that calls them, plus prices/price stickers (`btm.tag(label, item, size)`), distances, the viewer's spot (`where`/`set_where`/`opts`, store key `where`), hearts (`toggle_save` syncs every `[data-save=key]` on the page), `age_gate()`, `pick_spot()`, `edit_spot()`.
- **Photos** come from `<api origin>/photo?k=` (server `Photos.py`); `startup.py` sets `window.APP_API`.
- **18+**: `ages.py` turns a TextBox into a native date input (read `state.control(box).value`); sign-up and Google-from-Create-account call `finish_signup` (auth.py), which disables + signs out under-18s. Sell/ask/send open Dialogs/AgeGate when `me.adult` is false.
- **Sell** uploads each photo right after shrinking (`upload_photo` via call_s); Post waits until no tile is "up". The done screen adds an `Items.Card` into a LinearPanel.
- **Messages** polls `poll_chat` every 4 s; `router.show()` calls the old page's `leave()` to stop it. Shell polls `badges` every 40 s for the dot on Chats (`Shell.set_unread`).
- **Admin → Reports** nests `Items.AdminListing` (report mode via `_report_id`, callback `_on_change`) inside `Items.ReportRow`.
- **CSS**: app.css = tokens + template core + role layer + the garage-sale skin/pages (hard offset shadows are the identity). The price sticker is `.bt-tag` (static HTML) or Label role `tag` (+ `tag-free|tag-offer`, `tag-big|tag-inline`).
- Server code is unchanged except type annotations for `anvil validate` (Market offset/limit, `getattr(anvil.server, "session")`, `changes: dict`).
- Tests: `python tools/check.py`; `python -I tools/ui_test.py --only smoke.js` (every address as guest, member, admin + dialogs + asking a seller).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **chats**: key:str, listing→listings, title:str, buyer→users, seller→users, created:dt, last_at:dt, last_text:str, last_sender→users, buyer_unread:num, seller_unread:num, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Chat, DemoData, Market, Selling
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **listings**: owner→users, key:str, title:str, price:num, price_mode:str, note:str, status:str, area:str, lat:num, lng:num, photo_keys:obj, created:dt, bumped:dt, sold_at:dt, views:num, hidden:bool, hidden_reason:str, is_demo:bool · used in Accounts, Admin, DemoData, Market, Selling
- **messages**: chat→chats, sender→users, text:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Chat, DemoData
- **photos**: owner→users, listing→listings, key:str, image:media, thumb:media, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Photos, Selling
- **reports**: listing→listings, reporter→users, reason:str, details:str, status:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Market, Selling
- **saves**: user→users, listing→listings, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Market, Selling
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, adult_confirmed_at:dt, public_key:str, spot_label:str, spot_lat:num, spot_lng:num · used in Admin, DemoData, Market

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
